outcome: normalization of serum beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (beta-hCG) levels
cohort: 220 patients with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) at the Family Planning Department of the Women's Hospital, School of Medicine, Zhejiang University, from January 2019 to December 2019
finding: No significant difference in treatment success rates was found between different treatment methods for CSP, but gestational sac diameter, myometrial thickness, fetal heartbeat, and CSP subtype were significant factors in treatment selection.
